catalog_constraints: Full gate/up fused weights have 135790592 elements, exceeding the 100000000-element tensor bound.
Retaining all permissible split gate/up fused weights across 28 layers requires 7604273152 BF16 bytes, exceeding the 7 GiB prefix budget before other caches.
No custom fused normalization, residual or MLP epilogue kernels, sparse updates or incremental cache mutation are available.
Remaining image hidden states depend on changing image tokens; unconditional first-stage prefix reuse has no preservation argument.
Final image normalization and projection are fixed evaluator operations after the editable layer DAG.
limitations: Candidate reward comparisons use separate evaluations and are not paired statistical tests between candidates.
Hidden prompts and formal 256-stage evaluation remain untested.
